_provenance: Hook stdin payload SHAPES captured live from an isolated --plugin-dir probe on Claude Code 2.1.90 (2026-08-11). The probe plugin still used pre-rename skill names (plan/quick); the field shapes are identical, so the command/skill strings below are updated to the final dev-* entrypoints (dev router, dev-full/dev-quick skills). Volatile fields (session_id, transcript_path, cwd, tool_use_id) are redacted.

_findings.UserPromptExpansion: NOT a valid hooks key in 2.1.90 settings.json (Invalid key in record). The direct-slash path uses UserPromptSubmit.
_findings.directSlashPath: A direct /harnie:dev-full (skill is the entrypoint, no wrapper command) fires UserPromptSubmit ONLY and does NOT invoke the Skill tool — so no PreToolUse Skill event. The skill body loads deterministically.
_findings.routerPath: /harnie:dev (router command) or a natural-language request makes the model call the Skill tool -> PreToolUse Skill fires with the resolved skill (harnie:dev-full | harnie:dev-quick) and args.
_findings.exit2: exit 2 from a hook on EITHER event blocks the invocation (fail-closed): UserPromptSubmit blocks the prompt; PreToolUse Skill blocks the Skill tool call.
_findings.bootstrapMatch: bootstrap.mjs: UserPromptSubmit matches raw prompt ^/harnie:dev-full(?:\s|$) -> bootstrap; ^/harnie:dev(?:\s|$) -> write pending-route; dev-quick/non-harnie -> no-op. PreToolUse Skill keys off tool_input.skill === 'harnie:dev-full' -> bootstrap; 'harnie:dev-quick' -> clear pending-route.
